frame.name: FormShell
frame.description: The visual surface a form sits on.

frame.name: PageTitle
frame.description: Page heading, subtitle and supporting actions.

parts.name: Continue
parts.description: Intermediate clicks advance the supplied sequence. The final click submits the shared form; pending navigation disables repeat activation.

parts.name: Full-screen surface
